status: Draft exact record contract for concurrent checker implementation; not yet a frozen numerical protocol

input_fields.initial_state: [8,4] ordered z1,a1,z2,a2; fixed independently of theta
input_fields.drive2: [16,8] fixed external drives before interlayer link

protocol_fields.source_sha256: All runnable model/audit/train/reference/checker sources and README/requirements before first evaluation

trace: Defined by two_layer_common.pack_trace; 17x8x4 states, two 17x8x3 Q/R/x, two actual raw b/V arrays[17,8], layer1 shared theta[9], layer2 dynamic theta[17,8,9], link[16,8], used_drive2[16,8], drift[16,8,4], raw1/raw2 snapshots; actual phase is sign(V-b). Audit includes actual tanh1[9], tanh2/preactivation[16,8,9]. Training may omit tanh/preactivation only, retaining all effective theta.

audit.financial_reference: 16 entries with step,raw1[8,5],jac1[8,5,10],raw2[8,5],jac2[8,5,10]; represented assets and effective theta come from full trace

each.unused: Per-requested-tensor None flags; zeros materialized only in numeric records
each.trace_checks: dict from common; all finite/shape/domain/static-b1/dynamic-b2 gates

audit.full_local_decomposition: All keys from compose_local stacked in time: A,B,K_drive,K_condition,D1,D2,G1,G2,margin_theta,margin_z,boundary_raw1_drive,boundary_raw1_condition

training.history: 12 entries iteration,loss_before_update,raw1_before,raw2_before,grad_raw1,grad_raw2,trajectory,trace_checks,raw1_after,raw2_after; trace/raw snapshots captured BEFORE optimizer.step
training.checks: complete history,18 parameters only,finite gradients/parameters,both raw groups actually updated,and trace gates

checker_scope: Recompute source/input binding, all counts/shapes/finiteness, FP32 Euler and both link formulas, actual V<=raw_b classification, dynamic b2, all four same-value traces, 4x4/18-parameter reference using archived raw financial fields/J and actual tanh, all route/gradient tests, terminal physical loss and parameter update chain. No optimizer replay, no need to run model or open new financial points. financial-root verifies original protocol/binary/source identities; input raw/J are from the full audit's fixed frozen kernel calls.
